Nit: the comment, variable name and the variable comment are at odds with one another, and none match the explanation below 😅  I am taking the explanation below as source of truth.

```
# Post-transaction nonce structures
class AccountNonce(Container):
    address: Address  # account address
    nonce_before: Nonce  # nonce value after block execution
```
